_note: Step-by-step clues for Statements and Decisions (Chapter 36): the book questions and the past-paper questions filed under the chapter, by question id. The clues are the method, the same for every question with circles: draw each statement as circles, look for a second drawing that still fits the statements, and keep only the decisions that are true in every drawing. The last clue never names the option. Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_clues.ts checks them.

A decision follows only if it is true in every drawing. Check each one: which option lists exactly those?
